chunk_findings.detail: The fix assumes that merely creating `tree/.venv` makes a later `uv pip install -e .` target that environment. That is false when the command inherits `VIRTUAL_ENV` pointing at the primary shared `.venv`, which is the normal situation when ddflow and its console scripts are being run from that venv. `uv pip install` gives precedence to an active `VIRTUAL_ENV` over a `.venv` discovered from the current directory, so after `create()` has made `.ddflow/worktrees/DX-bug-repro-verify/.venv`, running `uv pip install -e .` in that worktree can still install into `/primary/.venv` and rewrite `_editable_impl_ddflow_mcp.pth` to the worktree. The diff does not clear/override `VIRTUAL_ENV`, prepend the worktree venv to `PATH`, or otherwise bind subsequent worktree commands to the new interpreter, so the original failure path remains reachable.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/infra/worktree/_create.py:42

chunk_findings.detail: The created venv is not usable for the documented `pip install -e .` path. `uv venv` without `--seed` creates a bare virtual environment that does not contain `pip`. If an agent or user activates the new worktree `.venv` and runs `pip install -e .`, `pip` is missing; if the shell instead falls back to the shared primary venv’s `pip`, the editable install again repoints the shared `.pth`. The docstring explicitly claims `pip install -e .` will resolve the worktree environment, but this command as written does not provide that guarantee.

chunk_findings.detail: The added `--seed` only puts a `pip` executable inside the worktree’s new `.venv`; it does not make a bare `pip install -e .` command in the worktree use that environment. pip chooses the environment of the `pip` executable/interpreter that is on `PATH`, not the current directory’s `.venv`. In the reported bug environment, ddflow’s shared `.venv/bin` is on `PATH` while `VIRTUAL_ENV` is unset, so after `isolate_venv` creates `.ddflow/worktrees/DX-bug-repro-verify/.venv`, running `pip install -e .` inside that worktree still invokes the shared venv’s pip, installs the editable package into the shared venv, and repoints `_editable_impl_ddflow_mcp.pth` at the worktree. When the worktree is later removed, `ddflow` again fails with `ModuleNotFoundError`; the worktree-local pip is used only if the shell activates the worktree venv or explicitly invokes `.venv/bin/pip`/`uv pip`.
